svg.title: Pascal triangle supplies the binomial coefficients
svg.desc: Rows zero through five contain coefficients for the corresponding nonnegative integer powers. Rows are one; one one; one two one; one three three one; one four six four one; and one five ten ten five one. The two threes in row three add to the six beneath them in row four. Row five produces the full expansion of one plus x to the fifth power.
